name: NE
recent: Northeast Group Berhad 近期有多项董事及主要股东持股变动公告，300股，以及董事经理 Ng Chay Chin 在8月底增持249,500股、独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon 同日减持130万股。新闻方面，有报道提及公司面临产能限制，但光子学领域的机会正浮现。最新财报显示2026年6月止季度营收同比增35.3%，净利同比增38.8%，但净利环比下降20.1%。
notable: 董事经理 Ng Chay Chin 于2026年8月26日增持249,500股普通股。
独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon 于2026年8月26日减持1,300,000股普通股。
risks: 独立非执行主席 Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon 在8月底减持130万股。
有新闻报道提及公司面临产能限制。

recent_en: Northeast Group Berhad recently saw several changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including Independent Non-Executive Director Ong Kim Nam disposing a total of about 106,300 shares over two days in early October, while Managing Director Ng Chay Chin acquired 249,500 shares and Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon disposed 1.3 million shares on the same day in late August. In the news, a report noted capacity constraints at the company despite photonics opportunities coming its way. The latest financial results for the quarter ended June 2026 showed revenue up 35.3% year-on-year and net profit up 38.8% year-on-year, while net profit fell 20.1% quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Ong Kim Nam disposed a total of 106,300 ordinary shares in three transactions between 5 and 7 October 2026.
Managing Director Ng Chay Chin acquired 249,500 ordinary shares on 26 August 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon disposed 1,300,000 ordinary shares on 26 August 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Ong Kim Nam sold shares in early October.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Kah Choon disposed 1.3 million shares in late August.
A news report mentioned capacity constraints at the company.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR42,851,000, up 35.3% year-on-year and up 11.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR9,852,000, up 38.8% year-on-year but down 20.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 23.0%, lower than 32.0% in the previous quarter.
